importantFindings.title: Partly fixed: Esci is now in every state, but the choice screen still has no way to wipe the device
importantFindings.evidence: Esci holds. Output: 'CONNECTED buttons: Tieni questo corso | Salva file | Tieni questo corso | Salva file | Esci', the same when offline, and 'READ-ONLY buttons: Esci | Cerca aggiornamenti'. After Esci: 'courses: 2', no stored session keys, no email on the page, and the sign-in form shown. The reset half of the finding remains: 'SIGNED OUT buttons: Tieni questo corso | Salva file | Tieni questo corso | Salva file | Invia il link di accesso' has no Azzera. FullReset is reachable only from Impostazioni, which this screen replaces. A phone handed on with two courses of minors can sign out but keeps them, and any holder can save their files. Offline or read-only, the phone cannot remove them at all. Not a blocker: the success predicate does not ask for a wipe. The B7 section of 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md names reset among what was out of reach, so this needs a fix or an owner decision.
importantFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's r2/, test 'the file, the marks and the screen on a several session'.

qolFindings.title: A course that arrives in an empty session and leaves before any reopen is never marked, so its rows stay in free pages
qolFindings.evidence: src/persistence/backupLink.ts courseChangedUnderSession returns null when the bound course is null, so nothing reloads and no mark is written. Marks are written only by an open or by saveActiveCourse (src/persistence/migrations.ts settleHeldCourses, src/persistence/courses.ts). Output: 'VISIT raw: true only X here: true'. Narrow: the device must sit on Crea corso while one course arrives and is then swapped for another. Reloading when a course arrives under an empty session would close it. Not a blocker: the round 1 scenario, a device holding a course it had opened, is closed.
qolFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's r2/p.spec.ts, test 'a course that arrives and leaves within one empty session'. Download simulated by direct ps_data writes.

qolFindings.title: Fixed for a marked device; open only when this build's first open is read-only
qolFindings.evidence: Output: 'RO first=false marks: local:held-course:<X> raw student: false', so the claim holds after a read-only period. 'RO first=true marks: local:held-course:<X> raw student: true': a device with no mark yet stays dirty, because src/persistence/migrations.ts returns before settleHeldCourses on a read-only open. It needs a device whose first open of a marking build is already below the minimum writer.
qolFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's r2/, the tests named 'read-only period, first open of this build'.

qolFindings.title: The shared lock can deadlock keep_course with a concurrent course-row upload; Postgres resolves it with no data effect seen
qolFindings.evidence: 150 rounds of keep_course against two concurrent course-row updates on local Postgres: 142 clean, 8 with 40P01. In 3 keep_course was the victim and rolled back; in the other 5 keep_course succeeded and an upload was the victim. Every state stayed one of those outcomes. Likely cause, reasoned: an update holds the row lock before its BEFORE ROW trigger asks for the advisory lock, while keep_course takes the advisory lock and then the row lock. By reading src/backup/uploadPolicy.ts and session.ts, an upload retries and keep_course reads as 'no-answer', whose Riprova is safe; not run on PostgREST. No privacy effect. Pass it to the sync-chaos reviewer.
qolFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's r2/keep.mjs, section 'keep against concurrent uploads of a course row'.

qolFindings.title: The id of an erased course stays in raw database blocks, in no table
qolFindings.evidence: Output after an erase and one more open: 'ID stores: cvc-helper.db/blocks:2of107', 'ID tables: ' (empty), 'ID localStorage: ' (empty), 'NAME stores: ' (empty). The swap case likewise gives 'raw, given-up student: false' but raw id true. The id is random and holds no personal data. Its only link is to the 8 characters in a saved file's name. I did not determine the cause, so I cannot say whether the marks add to it.
qolFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's r2/p.spec.ts, test 'where the id of an erased course stays'.

qolFindings.title: The newer-change check trusts device clocks
qolFindings.evidence: supabase/migrations/20261104000000_keep_course.sql compares updatedAt text. An edit stamped earlier than the last change the owner saw, from a clock-behind phone, does not answer CVNEW and goes with the course. It is limited to the owner's own course and the owner named that course. Read from the SQL, not run.

SP-B7-3 re-tested, resolved, on local Postgres with Supabase-like default grants. An unnamed course or a newer change answers CVNEW with nothing changed, as .evidence/B7/keep-rule-local-postgres.txt also records. My own run: non-object give_up values answer CVNEW; a nested value only affects the caller's own course; 'own id, naming the courses of the victim: kept' leaves the victim's courses and adds no erased id; an owner with no courses gets CVGON; an owner with one course and an empty map is a no-op. The DELETE now covers the same array as the erased record.

Other access questions on the new function: routine_privileges lists authenticated, postgres, service_role, not anon. 'anon, real course: error 42501' with the courses unchanged. 'foreign real id' and 'made-up id' give the identical CVGON message, so the function reveals no existence. service_role with no sub gets CVGON.

Advisory lock key: it is a hash of the owner's uuid, so nothing readable is stored, and the same text form and seed are used on both sides. A foreign insert with ownerId set to the victim gives 42501 whether or not the id was erased by the victim, so there is no oracle of erased ids. It held no advisory lock in the failed transaction ('advisory locks held in the failed transaction: 0') and made no session wait ('sessions waiting: 0'). I did not establish why no lock is taken, only that none was.

Marks: the saved file holds none. 'FILE holds held-course: false local:: false the other course: false email: false', top-level keys format, formatVersion, dataVersion, tables. After an erase the mark stays until the next open ('ERASE marks right after: 1', 'ERASE next open, marks: 0'); it holds only the random id. The full reset deletes the database (src/persistence/localDataOperations.ts), read from code.
